notes.title: Framing Dawes Demo - release date 20 March 2020
notes.notes:
Greetings!

As some of you are aware, the demo has been available to play on itch.io for a couple of months but not on Steam.It's been a challenge that's for sure, but I'm thrilled to announce that the demo will be released here on Steam, this Friday, for free!

I'd love to hear your feedback, what you liked /didn't like, suggestions, questions.... anything at all that falls into the constructive criticism category. I want to know what you think so I can ultimately make the full game a more engaging and enjoyable experience.

I have a Discord channel and I'd love you join:

http://discord.gg/WzeZD4k

This will be a good place for general discussion and for bug tracking.

And please do keep safe, it's an unsettling time for everyone. Look after yourselves <3 <3
